extraction.Name: Frank Arcoren (Dec'd)
extraction.NOTES: Frank Arcoren is deceased, died in 1920. Document is a questionnaire answered by his mother, Josephine Arcoren, age 60, who signed with a mark (witnessed). Frank was divorced at the time he sold his land and left no children. Josephine Arcoren has four dependents. Notarized June 11, 1929, by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32.
extraction.Literate/Illiterate: Josephine Arcoren signed with a mark
